title: The 8 Best Miter Saw Stand 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for miter saw stand 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at miter saw stand 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: DEWALT DWX726 Miter Saw Stand with Wheels
products.blurb: Key specs: Rolling design, 300 lb capacity, Pneumatic-assist wheels.
strengths: Pneumatic-assist raising and lowering makes one-person setup and pack-down fast
300 lb capacity handles the great majority of 10 and 12-inch miter saws
Universal mounting rail adapts to nearly any miter saw brand
Folds compact for transport in a truck or cargo van, with up to 8 feet of material support
limitations: Heavier than non-rolling stands -- more effort to carry short distances
Highest price in the budget-to-mid range
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Bosch T4B Gravity-Rise Miter Saw Stand with Wheels
products.blurb: Key specs: Gravity-rise mechanism, One-person setup, Rolling.
strengths: Gravity-rise mechanism deploys and folds with one foot pedal -- no lifting required
The fastest stand deployment and pack-down
Rolling for job site mobility
The most ergonomic stand design for solo woodworkers setting up repeatedly
limitations: Higher price than DeWalt rolling stand
Gravity-rise mechanism adds weight compared to manually folded stands

products.name: RIDGID AC9944 Mobile Miter Saw Stand
products.blurb: Key specs: Rolling, Articulating extensions, 400 lb capacity.
strengths: Articulating support extensions fold and lock in multiple positions for odd-length material
400 lb capacity handles most miter saws
The most practical value rolling miter saw stand
Ridgid lifetime warranty applies to this stand in many retail configurations
limitations: 400 lb capacity vs 500 lb for DeWalt
Ridgid mounting brackets fit Ridgid saws best -- adapters may be needed for other brands
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Milwaukee 48-08-0550 Miter Saw Stand
products.blurb: Key specs: Milwaukee One-Key compatible, 500 lb capacity, Rolling.
strengths: 500 lb capacity with rolling design at mid-market price
Milwaukee One-Key compatible for job site asset tracking
Universal mount fits most major miter saw brands
Milwaukee quality control with professional contractor target market
limitations: One-Key feature is irrelevant for home shop use
Folding mechanism requires more steps than Bosch gravity-rise

products.name: Metabo HPT UU240R Fold and Roll Miter Saw Stand
products.blurb: Key specs: Fold and roll design, Large 8-inch rubber wheels, Universal quick-release brackets.
strengths: One of the lighter rolling stands-- easier to carry in and out of work areas than steel cabinet-style stands
Large 8-inch rubber wheels roll well over job site debris
Universal quick-release mounting brackets fit up to a 12-inch sliding miter saw
The correct stand for woodworkers who move their stand frequently and want a simpler fold mechanism than gravity-rise designs
limitations: Not as fast to deploy as the Bosch gravity-rise mechanism
Heavier than a bare, non-rolling folding-leg stand

products.name: Craftsman 9-16490 Universal Deluxe Miter Saw Stand with Wheels
products.blurb: Key specs: Rolling design, Budget price, Adjustable steel rollers.
strengths: One of the lowest price rolling miter saw stands adequate for home shop use
Adjustable steel roller extensions support long boards on both sides
Universal mounting brackets fit most 10 and 12-inch miter saws
The correct stand for home shop woodworkers on a tighter budget who still want wheels
limitations: Less durable construction than professional-grade stands
Weight capacity is lower than DeWalt or Bosch
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: Festool UG Kapex Wheeled Underframe Mobile Stand
products.blurb: Key specs: Festool Kapex system, Aluminum construction, Extension wing system to 120 inches.
strengths: Purpose-built for the Festool Kapex sliding compound miter saw -- integrated bracket fit
Aluminum construction keeps the stand light at 31 lbs while supporting up to 265 lbs
Extension wing system reaches up to 120 inches total length for long material support
German engineered to Festool quality -- built to last a career
limitations: Very high price -- designed specifically around the Kapex saw
The integration benefits apply mainly to Kapex owners
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: BORA Portamate PM-4000 Universal Miter Saw Stand
products.blurb: Key specs: Folding leg design, Quick-release mounting brackets, 500 lb capacity.
strengths: Quick-release mounting brackets let the saw come off the stand for bench use in seconds
500 lb capacity handles the heaviest 12-inch compound sliding saws
Folding leg design is simpler and lighter than a rolling cabinet-style stand
Materials cost is lower than most rolling commercial stands
limitations: No wheels -- must be carried, not rolled, between positions
Extension arms are fixed-position, not articulating, on the base model
